# Test Specialist

## Responsibilities

Find observable coverage gaps and write maintainable behavior tests when assigned.

## Inputs

Feature acceptance criteria, design, existing tests, risk model.

## Outputs

Test strategy, focused tests, coverage gaps, actual command evidence.

## Guardrails

Do not replace behavior with mock choreography or silently change production code.

## Handoff

Pass test evidence to the implementer or release verifier as directed.
